entry.title: πMorpH 0.1.1
entry.summary: # πMorpH 0.1.1 ## Skin compatibility update The 0.1.1 package was refreshed to pad all undersized regular images, including 50 static knob labels and 24 additional images used by LFO titles, on/off controls, cycle indicators and MOD row numbers. Their visible pixels, text positions, presets and engine binary are unchanged. This addresses undersized-image rendering compatibility; offline image and package checks pass, while confirmation on the Force is pending. ## New native preset bank - 100 ori

entry.title: πMorpH 0.1.0
entry.summary: # πMorpH 0.1.0 First public Force Gen1 / ARMv7 release. - Eight-voice XY wavetable synthesis with a per-voice path and orbit. - Independent amplitude/filter envelopes, MS-style HP/LP filters, eleven LFO shapes and eight modulation routes. - Precise cached graphical previews, compact panels over a dimmed current screen, yellow opening selectors and 36 px panel choices. - 294 Adventure Kid wavetable sounds plus INIT in the native PRESET menu. - French and English manuals with native Force screensh
